tools.name: add_inventory_product
tools.description: Add a product to this API key's inventory. Optional category is food, beverage, baby, household, electronics, vehicle, medical_device, drug, cosmetics, pet, or other. Requires a verified account (sign in at https://app.recallkitchen.com with the signup email). Unverified signup keys cannot add inventory.

category.description: optional product category: food, beverage, baby, household, electronics, vehicle, medical_device, drug, cosmetics, pet, or other

tools.name: add_watch_pattern
tools.description: Add a recall watch pattern for this API key. Same websearch syntax as search_product_recalls (AND, OR, -exclude, quoted phrases). New matches show up in Recall Kitchen. Requires an API key.

pattern.description: websearch pattern: unquoted words are AND, OR is or, -term excludes, quoted phrases match as a unit

tools.name: check_tracked_products
tools.description: Check this API key's watch patterns and inventory against current indexed recalls (including historical notices). Does not create notifications. Generic patterns such as food or hazard only match in titles. Requires an API key.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an additional API key for this account. Requires an existing API key. Unverified accounts may have only one key; verified accounts may have three. Usage is counted per account, not per key.

kind.description: optional kind: user or agent, default agent

tools.name: get_product_recall
tools.description: Get a recall by id, including extracted lots, UPCs, model numbers, locations, contact info, and product photo URLs

recall_id.description: recall id returned by search tools

tools.name: give_feedback
tools.description: Report a bug, missing capability, bad search result, or confusing schema to the Recall Kitchen team. Use this instead of silently working around a problem. message is required and should include the MCP tool names you called, the actions you took, the query or identifiers, and any recall_id. Do not send API keys, photos, or PII. Optional category: bad_result, tool_error, missing_capability, confusing_schema, docs, other. Optional severity: blocked, workaround, annoyance. No API key or x402 required. Does not count against search quotas.

message.description: describe the problem. Include the MCP tool names you called, the actions you took, the query or identifiers, and any recall_id. Do not send API keys, photos, or PII.

category.description: optional: bad_result, tool_error, missing_capability, confusing_schema, docs, or other

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List this account's API keys (id, name, prefix, created). Secrets are not shown. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_inventory
tools.description: List this API key's tracked inventory products. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_recall_notifications
tools.description: List recall notifications for this API key. unread defaults to true (unread only); pass false for all. New matches show up in Recall Kitchen. Empty for new accounts until a new matching recall is published; not a backfill of check_tracked_products. message is a short plain-text summary. Requires an API key.

unread.description: if true, only unread notifications; if false, include read. Default: true (unread only)

tools.name: list_watch_patterns
tools.description: List this API key's recall watch patterns. Requires an API key.

tools.name: lookup_product
tools.description: Look up a product by UPC/EAN. Returns found=false when unknown. Does not search recalls.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark a recall notification as read (default) or unread. Requires an API key.

read.description: if true, mark read; if false, mark unread. Default true

tools.name: remove_inventory_product
tools.description: Remove a product from this API key's inventory by id. Requires an API key.

tools.name: remove_watch_pattern
tools.description: Remove a recall watch pattern for this API key. Requires an API key.

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by key_id from list_api_keys. Requires an API key. Revoking the current key will fail subsequent calls.

tools.name: search_product_recalls
tools.description: Search product recalls by query. Query uses websearch syntax: unquoted words are AND, OR is or, -term excludes, quoted phrases match as a unit (example: Generac Generator -Portable). Optional filters: source (cpsc, fdafoodsafety, FDAMedWatch, usda, nhtsa, canada, openfda), since/until (YYYY-MM-DD), location (country, region, or place, ANDed with the query), offset, limit. Descriptions are truncated and extracted products are capped; use get_product_recall for the full text.

query.description: websearch query: unquoted words are AND, OR is or, -term excludes, quoted phrases match as a unit. Example: Generac Generator -Portable

source.description: optional source filter: cpsc, fdafoodsafety, FDAMedWatch, usda, nhtsa, canada, or openfda. Aliases: FDA and food map to fdafoodsafety; medwatch maps to FDAMedWatch; vehicle, vin, and car map to nhtsa; healthcanada, cfia, and hc-sc map to canada; enforcement, res, and fdaenforcement map to openfda. For more than one source, pass sources.

sources.description: optional sources to include (OR). Same values as source

years.description: optional published window in years (1-50). Ignored when since is set

location.description: optional country, region, or place; ANDed with the query. USA, Canada, Mexico, EU, and Europe match places in that region. CA is California, not Canada.

limit.description: number of recalls to return, 1-100, default 3

tools.name: search_product_recalls_by_upc
tools.description: Search recalls by UPC/EAN or a barcode image URL/data URI/MCP image content. Matches extracted recall UPCs first. Returns found=false when the UPC is unknown.

image_url.description: optional HTTPS URL or data:image/...;base64 URI of a barcode image

limit.description: number of recalls to return, 1-100, default 3

tools.name: search_product_recalls_from_image
tools.description: Photo (beta): identify products in a public HTTPS image URL, data:image/...;base64 URI, or MCP image content part. Local files are not supported. Each product includes match (upc, model, text, category) and confidence. Category matches omit recalls unless include_category_matches=true. Requires an API key or x402; not included in the free anonymous per-IP quota.

image_url.description: photo (beta). HTTPS URL or data:image/...;base64 URI of a photo containing products. Local file paths are not supported.

limit.description: number of recalls to return per product, 1-100, default 3

include_category_matches.description: if true, attach keyword recalls for generic items such as cups; default false

tools.name: search_recalls_by_identifier
tools.description: Search recalls by extracted UPC, lot code, model number, product name, or VIN. Multiple identifiers are AND-matched on the same product. VIN lookup lists NHTSA campaigns for the decoded year and make; confirm your vehicle on nhtsa.gov/recalls. lot_code: Label prefixes (BB:, Lot#, Best By, Exp, etc.) are ignored. Extracted lots match exactly or as a prefix of at least 4 characters, after normalizing spaces, case, and punctuation. If lots were not extracted, notice title and description search needs at least 4 characters — verify against the notice. product_name falls back to the same full-text search as search_product_recalls when no exact extracted name matches, and returns a hint if still empty.

upc.description: product UPC or EAN as stored on the recall

lot_code.description: lot or batch code. Label prefixes (BB:, Lot#, Best By, Exp, etc.) are ignored. Extracted lots match exactly or as a prefix of at least 4 characters, after normalizing spaces, case, and punctuation. Lot-only lookup uses the extracted identifier index and does not search notice title and description. Combined with upc, model_number, or vin, notice text is also searched when no lots were extracted (at least 4 characters). Verify against the notice.

model_number.description: model number as stored on the recall

product_name.description: extracted product name (exact match; if none, falls back to the same full-text search as search_product_recalls)

vin.description: 17-character VIN. Lookup lists NHTSA campaigns for the decoded year and make; confirm your vehicle on nhtsa.gov/recalls.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Create a Recall Kitchen account and API key from an email. No API key or x402 payment required. Set accept_terms true only after you ask the person and they confirm they are 13 or older and accept the Terms (https://recallkitchen.com/terms), Privacy Policy (https://recallkitchen.com/privacy) and API Terms (https://recallkitchen.com/api-terms); never set it automatically or on the person's behalf. The key is returned once. Unverified accounts have lower rate limits (60 tool calls/hour, 400/day, one key) and can add a few watch patterns. Sign in at https://app.recallkitchen.com with the same email to verify, raise limits, and add inventory. Does not re-issue a key if the email already has an account.

email.description: email address for the new account

accept_terms.description: Set true only after you ask the person and they confirm they are 13 or older and accept the Terms (https://recallkitchen.com/terms), Privacy Policy (https://recallkitchen.com/privacy) and API Terms (https://recallkitchen.com/api-terms). Never set this automatically or on the person's behalf.
